scope: Round 2 on the same date: tolerance-based comparison of a fixed descriptive RNA-seq result bundle. This is a new implementation scope, not elapsed-time monitoring.
inclusion_criteria: Direct evidence for numerical comparison or file-integrity implementation behavior
Primary scientific papers only for their studied claim; official documentation for software semantics
exclusion_criteria: No new biological accuracy or performance claims inferred from implementation documentation

searches.query: ("computational biology"[Title/Abstract] OR bioinformatics[Title/Abstract]) AND "floating point"[Title/Abstract] AND reproducibility[Title/Abstract]
searches.query_translation: ("computational biology"[Title/Abstract] OR "bioinformatics"[Title/Abstract]) AND "floating point"[Title/Abstract] AND "reproducibility"[Title/Abstract] AND 2022/01/01:2026/10/20[Date - Publication]
searches.selection_limit: All returned records in this narrow result set screened; not a comprehensive literature search

screening.reason: No publication records were available to screen; official Python documentation appraised separately.

supplementary_resources.finding: Finite scalar relative/absolute comparison semantics; project tolerance is a declared engineering choice.
Decoder hooks allow rejecting nonfinite constants and duplicate keys; no third-party code copied.

limits: Bounded targeted update with one reviewer; original search-log.json remains unchanged
No cross-platform validation or independent scientific validation supplied by documentation
Supplementary direct URL retrieval has no exposed total search-result count
